subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should maintainers land this focused fresh-session fallback now, despite the known duplicate model/tool and possible second `--deliver` side effects, or wait for the reattach-first redesign tracked in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/98200?
rationale: The patch looks correct for the narrow session-corruption bug, but automation cannot decide whether the interim timeout-style two-run boundary is the desired accepted-disconnect product behavior.

options.title: Land focused interim fix
options.body: Merge after refresh because it stops same-session transcript collision while preserving the existing timeout-style recook fallback, with the broader reattach-first behavior left to the linked issue.

options.title: Extend to reattach-first now
options.body: Ask the contributor to implement the wait/read recovery path in this PR, reducing duplicate side effects but increasing behavior change and complexity.

options.title: Hold for recovery policy
options.body: Pause this PR until an owner chooses the accepted-disconnect recovery policy for interactive and `--deliver` runs.

recommendation.title: Land focused interim fix
recommendation.body: Merge after refresh because it stops same-session transcript collision while preserving the existing timeout-style recook fallback, with the broader reattach-first behavior left to the linked issue.
